games.title: Avoir and Être Arena
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to understand basic grammar appropriate to the language being studied, including (where relevant): feminine, masculine and neuter forms and the conjugation of high-frequency verbs; key features and patterns of the language; how to apply these, for instance, to build sentences; and how these differ from or are similar to English
games.instruction: Read the sentence, then tap the right verb.
games.hint: Not quite. Is it "to have" (avoir) or "to be" (être), and who is doing it? Try again.

questions.ask: Fill the gap with avoir: "J'… un chien." (I have a dog.)
Fill the gap with avoir: "Tu … un frère ?" (Do you have a brother?)
Fill the gap with être: "Il … grand." (He is tall.)
Fill the gap with être: "Nous … contents." (We are happy.)
Fill the gap with avoir: "Elles … deux chats." (They have two cats.)
Fill the gap with être: "Vous … français ?" (Are you French?)
Fill the gap with être: "Je … anglais." (I am English.)
Fill the gap with avoir: "Nous … une maison." (We have a house.)
In French, which verb do you use to say "I am ten years old"?

games.instruction: Read the sentence, then tap the right verb ending.
